text: Cendara University is committed to providing a transparent overview of the expected costs associated with enrollment. The fee ranges outlined below are for the academic year 2024–2025 and apply to both domestic and international students. Actual charges may vary based on chosen program, housing selection, dining preference, and individual course loads.
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure

locations.heading: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure

text:
Tuition varies by degree level and academic program. The following ranges represent annual full-time enrollment (24–30 credits undergraduate, 18–24 credits graduate):
- Program/Degree: Bachelor of Arts/Science/Engineering | Tuition Range (Per Year): $24,000 – $29,000
- Program/Degree: Bachelor of Business Administration/Nursing | Tuition Range (Per Year): $26,000 – $32,000
- Program/Degree: Bachelor of Education | Tuition Range (Per Year): $23,500 – $26,500
- Program/Degree: Master of Arts/Science/Engineering | Tuition Range (Per Year): $13,500 – $18,200
- Program/Degree: Master of Business Administration/Public Health | Tuition Range (Per Year): $17,800 – $21,400
- Program/Degree: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) | Tuition Range (Per Year): $16,500 – $23,000
- Program/Degree: Graduate Certificate Programs | Tuition Range (Per Year): $9,800 – $12,500 (per certificate)
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 1. Tuition

text:
- Part-Time Tuition: Calculated per credit hour, typically $900 – $1,200/credit (undergraduate); $1,050 – $1,500/credit (graduate)
- International students: Add $2,000 – $5,000 annually for certain programs
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 1. Tuition

text: All enrolled students are assessed general fees in addition to tuition.
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 2. Mandatory Fees

text:
- Fee Category: Student Activities Fee | Annual Range: $350 – $500 | Description: Supports clubs, programming, and student government
- Fee Category: Technology Fee | Annual Range: $250 – $400 | Description: Access to campus computing and online resources
- Fee Category: Health Services Fee | Annual Range: $175 – $350 | Description: On-campus health clinic, mental health support
- Fee Category: Library Fee | Annual Range: $90 – $140 | Description: Library resources and special collections
- Fee Category: Registration Fee | Annual Range: $70 – $120 | Description: Course registration and records management
- Fee Category: New Student Orientation | Annual Range: $120 – $200 | Description: One-time, for all first-time enrollees
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 2. Mandatory Fees

text: Cendara University offers several on-campus residence options. Costs vary by building, room type, and amenities.
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 3. Room (Housing)

text:
- Housing Option: Traditional Double | Annual Range: $5,400 – $6,800 | Notes: Shared room, communal bathroom
- Housing Option: Single (Private) | Annual Range: $7,200 – $9,100 | Notes: Private room, shared facilities
- Housing Option: Suite-Style (2–4 students) | Annual Range: $8,600 – $10,400 | Notes: Shared suite, en-suite bathroom
- Housing Option: Apartment (Upperclass/Grad only) | Annual Range: $9,800 – $12,250 | Notes: Kitchen, living room, private BR
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 3. Room (Housing)

text:
- Utilities and internet included in all campus housing
- Limited off-campus housing listings available ($450 – $950/month per person)
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 3. Room (Housing)

text:
Meal plans are required for first- and second-year residents.
- Plan Type: Platinum | Annual Range: $5,200 – $5,850 | Average Meals per Week: Unlimited dining hall + retail credit
- Plan Type: Gold | Annual Range: $4,600 – $5,100 | Average Meals per Week: 14 meals/week + snack credits
- Plan Type: Silver | Annual Range: $3,800 – $4,350 | Average Meals per Week: 10 meals/week + à la carte access
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 4. Board (Meal Plans)

text: - Graduate and apartment residents may opt out or select partial plans ($700 – $2,200/year)
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 4. Board (Meal Plans)

text: These costs are estimates and may vary by program or personal choices.
path: Cendara University Undergraduate and Graduate Fee Structure > 5. Additional/Estimated Expenses

text:
- Expense Category: Books & Materials | Range (Annual): $950 – $1,400 | Description: Varies by discipline and course load
- Expense Category: Course/Lab Fees | Range (Annual): $120 – $650 | Description: Charged for select courses (labs, art studios, etc.)
- Expense Category: Transportation | Range (Annual): $650 – $1,200 | Description: Local bus pass, occasional travel, parking if applicable
- Expense Category: Personal/Miscellaneous | Range (Annual): $1,300 – $2,100 | Description: Clothing, laundry, personal care, entertainment
- Expense Category: Health Insurance | Range (Annual): $1,750 – $3,150 | Description: Required for those without comparable coverage
- Expense Category: Study Abroad Fees | Range (Annual): $1,800 – $6,900 | Description: For approved global education program participants
- Expense Category: Graduation Fee | Range (Annual): $90 – $200 | Description: Assessed in final semester

text:
- Scholarships, grants, and financial aid are available; contact the Office of Financial Assistance for eligibility.
- Some specialized programs (e.g., Nursing, Engineering, Study Abroad) may charge additional instructional or experiential fees.
- All fees are subject to annual review and adjustment by the Board of Trustees.
- Billing is conducted on a semester basis; flexible payment plans are available upon request.
- Questions about campus fees should be addressed to bursar@cendara.edu.
